verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves the prior major finding. The document now clearly separates repository-established artifact topology from unverified GitHub Pages service state, identifies the service claims as an undated relay, and requires operators to query the Pages API and probe the live URL before acting. The checked workflow context supports the artifact-side statements: pages.yml folds benchmark-data/dev, checks the custom-domain CNAME and assembled dashboards, and is the deploy producer; docs.yml explicitly remains CI-artifact-only. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue remains in the diff.
